spec.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ambient_light")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")

actual = from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "ambient_light")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "value")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "actual")

predicted = from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "predicted_light")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "predicted_value")
  |> set(key: "_field", value: "predicted")

union(tables: [actual, predicted])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"])

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "prediction_error")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "error" or r._field == "ema_error")

spec.query:
from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "acceleration")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "ax" or r._field == "ay" or r._field == "az")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "impact_event")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "system"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["axis"], valueColumn: "value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "theft_event")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "system"])
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["axis"], valueColumn: "value")
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "actuator_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "alarm_state")
  |> last()
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "system"])

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "actuator_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "brightness")
  |> last()

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "actuator_state")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "brightness")

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "system"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: false)

from(bucket: v.bucket)
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop: v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "position")
  |> pivot(rowKey: ["_time"], columnKey: ["_field"], valueColumn: "_value")
  |> drop(columns: ["_start", "_stop", "system"])
  |> sort(columns: ["_time"], desc: true)
  |> limit(n: 1)
